about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: JSC «Plastik» is a leader in the Russian chemical industry in the ABS plastics segment. Founded in 1959, our enterprise continuously develops, exploring new directions and constantly modernizing.
about.paragraph2: We produce polymer raw materials that meet modern quality standards. Our products include six grades of expandable polystyrene, extrusion and injection grades of ABS plastics, as well as various plastic products used in industry and everyday life.
about.paragraph3: Our plant operates a quality management system certified for compliance with ISO 9001-2008 and GOST ISO 9001:2011. We do not inflate prices, so cooperation with JSC «Plastik» is profitable.

absPage.sectionIntro: A brief overview of injection grades (injection molding machines) and extrusion grades (sheets and profiles). The product catalog is in the subcategories above.

injection.title: Injection ABS plastic
injection.intro: A wide range of injection ABS plastic grades. The main processing method is injection molding on thermoplastic machines.
injection.footer: To purchase granulated ABS plastic at a competitive price, contact our company — granulated plastic that meets all quality standards.

advantages.title: High MFR
advantages.desc: Selected grades — flame retardancy, antistatic properties

extrusion.title: Extrusion ABS plastic
extrusion.intro: AO Plastik offers several grades of extrusion ABS plastic. In extrusion, the material is melted in an extruder, then pushed through a die, cooled and calibrated. Advantages of extrusion ABS include high impact properties, mechanical strength and rigidity.
extrusion.details: Grades in this section are most often used to produce sheets of various thickness with glossy or matte surfaces, and in some cases with embossing. Sheets are later vacuum- or pressure-formed into finished parts.
applications: interior and exterior automotive parts, including large body components;
structures used in the advertising industry;
housings for certain types of household appliances;
and other products made from extrusion ABS plastic.

styrenePage.title: Styrene
styrenePage.lead: A monomer for polystyrene, copolymers and synthetic rubber — the foundation of many polymer materials in the AO Plastik product range.
styrenePage.imageAlt: SDEB grade styrene — clear liquid, AO Plastik production
styrenePage.p1: Styrene (vinylbenzene) is a liquid aromatic hydrocarbon and the key building block in the polymer chain: expandable and extrusion polystyrene, ABS plastics, styrene-butadiene and styrene-containing rubbers, latices and other downstream products.
styrenePage.p2: High chemical purity of the monomer directly affects polymerization stability and the quality of the finished product — from sheets and profiles to machine parts and consumer goods. AO Plastik maintains strict control of specification parameters plus storage and shipping conditions.
styrenePage.gradeNote: This grade meets premium-grade styrene requirements for appearance, main substance content and impurities — see the table below.

pvcModifierPage.title: PVC Impact Modifier
pvcModifierPage.subtitle: Acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene impact and heat resistance modifier, grades ABS-20F/ABS-20P, ABS-28F/ABS-28P, ABS-15F/ABS-15P
pvcModifierPage.imageAlt: ABS modifier for PVC compounds — flakes and powder
pvcModifierPage.profilesImageAlt: Rigid PVC profiles — application area for impact modifier
pvcModifierPage.p1: Provides high impact strength, improves mechanical properties of rigid PVC profiles and increases their heat resistance. The finished product retains its impact resistance for a long time under any weather conditions thanks to UV stabilizer introduced during ABS synthesis. ABS modifiers are also excellent general-purpose processing aids with a wide processing window, reducing the need for multiple different processing modifiers for different applications.
pvcModifierPage.p2: The modifier opens additional opportunities in the production of building and housing products.
pvcModifierPage.brochureLabel: Download brochure for ABS-20F/20P, ABS-28F/28P, ABS-15F/15P modifiers
pvcModifierPage.articleLead: From the article by PhD G. Barsamyan in Plastiks magazine
pvcModifierPage.articleQuote: Besides acrylic modifiers and CPE, there is another product widely used as a PVC modifier — acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) copolymer, considered in the USA the most cost-effective impact modifier for PVC. AO Plastik (UzlOVaya) is the largest ABS producer in Russia. ABS testing as impact and processing modifier for PVC began in July 2016.
pvcModifierPage.articleResultsTitle: PVC samples with ABS modifier were tested at NIC Wood-Polymer Composites LLC with the following results:
articleResults: reduced brittleness and 9% increase in impact strength
17% increase in extrusion speed compared to the current formulation
pvcModifierPage.articleLink: Full text: PhD G.B. Barsamyan / Modifiers for rigid PVC / Plastiks No. 3/2017

korsPage.corsLead: Cubic residue of styrene rectification — a styrene production by-product used as fuel, solvent and a component of industrial materials.
korsPage.corsAlt: CORS — cubic residue of styrene rectification
korsPage.corsP1: CORS (cubic residue of styrene rectification) is a by-product of styrene production.
korsPage.corsP2: It is used as fuel in some modern heating systems and boilers. CORS is also a solvent and a component in various types of industrial production.
korsPage.corsP3: The main application is film-forming materials. CORS residues are also used to improve mechanical strength and reduce static in rubber-based floor coatings, and for impregnating wood and fibreboard to improve moisture resistance, strength and durability.
korsPage.corsP4: CORS quality from AO Plastik meets TU 2415-038-05762341-2012, rev. 1, 2, 3.
korsPage.bentolLead: Benzene-toluene fraction — a processing product used as feedstock and solvent across several industries.
korsPage.bentolAlt: Bentol — benzene-toluene fraction, 500 ml lab bottle
korsPage.bentolP1: Bentol is a liquid hydrocarbon mixture (mainly benzene and toluene) with composition and physico-chemical properties regulated by specifications. It is used as a solvent and feedstock component in paints, enamels and binders, and in rubber, adhesives and other organic synthesis where controlled aromatic hydrocarbon content is required.
korsPage.bentolP2: Depending on the customer's process chain, Bentol can be used to adjust viscosity of coatings, accelerate drying of film coatings, and in formulations for polymer and rubber product processing. Delivery complies with labelling, packaging and safe transport requirements for chemicals.
korsPage.bentolP3: AO Plastik ensures consistent batch quality: fraction parameters meet approved TU limits, confirmed by incoming raw material control and acceptance testing of finished product.
korsPage.bentolP4: Bentol from AO Plastik meets TU 2415-032-05762341-2009.
